en.headline: PolyU students open speculative furniture exhibition on Hong Kong’s future in Tsim Sha Tsui
en.dek: Henceforth… Hong Kong… runs free at The Grid in Heath Mall from 10 to 24 November, with nine pieces exploring density, ageing and resources over the next 50 years.
body: The School of Design at the Hong Kong Polytechnic University has opened an exhibition of speculative furniture pieces created by students in its BA (Hons) in Environmental Design programme.

Titled Henceforth… Hong Kong… — Physical Furniture × Virtual Futures, the show features nine works that respond to future challenges shaped by density, ageing populations and resource constraints. Each piece carries two dates: the year it was made and the future year it was designed for.

The exhibition runs from 10 to 24 November at The Grid, Heath Mall, B/F, 36-44 Nathan Road in Tsim Sha Tsui. Admission is free and no registration is required. Visitors can touch the materials and sit on the furniture; selected sessions include VR experiences of future scenarios.
The Hong Kong Furniture and Decoration Trade Association is the furniture collaborator, with Heath as venue partner. The show is presented as part of the broader DESIGN@HKG programme.

zh.headline: 理大設計學生尖沙咀展出構想未來香港的家具作品
zh.dek: 「今後香港」展覽即日起至十一月二十四日在希慎道商場The Grid免費舉行，九件作品探討未來五十年密度、人口老化與資源問題。
body: 香港理工大學設計學院環境設計（榮譽）文學士課程學生創作的構想家具作品展覽已經開幕。
展覽題為「今後香港——實體家具 × 虛擬未來」，展出九件作品，回應密度、人口老化及資源限制所塑造的未來挑戰。每件作品標示兩個年份：製作年份及所構想的未來年份。
展覽由十一月十日至二十四日在尖沙咀彌敦道36-44號希慎道商場地下The Grid舉行。免費入場，毋須預約。參觀者可觸摸物料及坐下試用家具；部分時段設虛擬實境體驗，從家具角度觀看未來情境。
香港家具裝飾業總會為家具合作伙伴，希慎為場地伙伴。展覽屬設計@HKG計劃的一部分。
